criteria.core: a run of core.yml exists at the landed SHA and every one of its jobs concluded success, including core, s01-storage-roundtrip
criteria.desktopBrowser: a run of desktop-browser.yml exists at the landed SHA and every one of its jobs concluded success, including desktop-browser
criteria.docs: a run of docs.yml exists at the landed SHA and every one of its jobs concluded success, including docs
criteria.frontend: a run of frontend.yml exists at the landed SHA and every one of its jobs concluded success, including frontend
criteria.landingWasFastForward: the previous SHA is an ancestor of the landed SHA, so this is the landing it claims to be and not an unrelated tree
criteria.portalLoginHarness: a run of portal-login-harness.yml exists at the landed SHA and every one of its jobs concluded success, including portal-login-harness
